# === Import ===

--8<-- [start:import]
-import_from(py.scipy_cluster, [linkage, flat_cluster, ...])
--8<-- [end:import]


# === Predicate catalogue ===

--8<-- [start:hierarchical_clustering]
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
# Z is the linkage matrix for ward hierarchical clustering
--8<-- [end:hierarchical_clustering]

--8<-- [start:hierarchical_clustering_ex2]
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
flat_cluster(Z, 3, 'maxclust', LABELS),
# LABELS[i] is the cluster number for observation i
--8<-- [end:hierarchical_clustering_ex2]

--8<-- [start:hierarchical_clustering_ex3]
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
dendrogram(Z, D),
ResultGet(D, 'leaves', LEAVES),
# LEAVES is the list of leaf node indices
--8<-- [end:hierarchical_clustering_ex3]

--8<-- [start:hierarchical_clustering_ex4]
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
Y is ++(pdist(DATA)),
cophenet(Z, Y, RESULT),
ResultGet(RESULT, 'c', C),
# C is the cophenetic correlation coefficient (1.0 = perfect)
--8<-- [end:hierarchical_clustering_ex4]

--8<-- [start:hierarchical_clustering_ex5]
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
inconsistent(Z, STATS),
# STATS[i, 3] is the inconsistency coefficient for merge i
--8<-- [end:hierarchical_clustering_ex5]

--8<-- [start:vector_quantisation]
k_means(DATA, 2, RESULT),
ResultGet(RESULT, 'codebook', CODEBOOK),
ResultGet(RESULT, 'distortion', D),
# D is the mean Euclidean distance to the nearest centroid
--8<-- [end:vector_quantisation]


# === Typical pipeline ===

--8<-- [start:typical_pipeline]
# 1. Load and whiten data
whiten(RAW_DATA, DATA),

# 2. Hierarchical clustering to explore structure
linkage(DATA, 'ward', Z),
flat_cluster(Z, 3, 'maxclust', LABELS),

# 3. k-means for production assignment
k_means(DATA, 3, KR),
ResultGet(KR, 'codebook', CODEBOOK),
vector_quantize(DATA, CODEBOOK, VQR),
ResultGet(VQR, 'code', ASSIGNMENTS).
--8<-- [end:typical_pipeline]
